# Benchmarks

Legacy micro-suite (`*.php` here) plus **v2** under `benchmarks/v2/` (#36385).

**Do not hand-edit timing numbers.** Every figure in the tables below is regenerated by
`script/bench.php`. Narrative speedup claims belong only in text that points at a generated
table or `benchmarks/v2/RESULTS.json` — never as standalone hand-typed ratios.

## Legacy micro-suite

Regenerate the table between the markers:

```bash
./script/docker-exec.sh -- bash -lc 'source script/php-env.sh && PHP_8_2=$(command -v php) php script/bench.php'
```

## Reading the columns

- `Zend` — php-src CLI baseline.
- `bin/vm.php` / `bin/jit.php` — interpreter / MCJIT; `n/a` when output mismatches Zend or the run hits the time cap.
- `phpc build` — compile wall time (not run time).
- `native run` — standalone AOT binary wall time; compare this to `Zend`.

`n/a` is intentional honesty in `script/bench.php` (build failure, timeout, or wrong output) — not a silent pass.

## Suite v2 (strings / arrays / objects / web)

```bash
./script/docker-exec.sh -- bash -lc 'source script/php-env.sh && PHP_8_2=$(command -v php) php script/bench.php --v2'
./script/bench-gate.sh --v2
php script/bench-web-request.php --merge-results   # MiniWebApp req/s column
php script/generate-bench-chart.php                # docs/pages/bench.html
```

Numbers live in:

- `benchmarks/v2/README.md` (generated table)
- `benchmarks/v2/RESULTS.json`
- `benchmarks/v2/WEB_REQUEST.json`
- `benchmarks/history/<sha>.json` when `PHP_COMPILER_BENCH_HISTORY=1`
- Chart: `docs/pages/bench.html`

## Optimisation level

`PHP_COMPILER_OPT_LEVEL` selects the LLVM IR pipeline (default **0**). Raising it can change
both compile time and native run time; regenerate the tables above after changing it. Defaulting
the pipeline on is blocked on side-loaded extensions (#23480) — the IR module is dominated by the
linked stdlib, not the user program.

**Performance gate:** `script/bench-gate.sh` (legacy) and `script/bench-gate.sh --v2` compare
AOT/Zend ratios and LLVM IR size against committed baselines. Refresh a baseline only after a
verified perf fix (`--update`).
